Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | HIPAA + Illinois Medicaid

sections.title: Chicago Healthcare AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for Chicago healthcare AI development.

blocks.heading: Illinois BIPA and clinical biometrics
paragraphs: BIPA's prohibition on collecting biometric identifiers without written consent applies to clinical AI that uses fingerprint, facial, or voice biometric features. ClickMasters designs Chicago clinical AI without biometric data collection by default — using alternative patient identification approaches compliant with BIPA.

blocks.heading: Illinois Mental Health Code
paragraphs: The Illinois Mental Health and Developmental Disabilities Confidentiality Act creates confidentiality protections for mental health records that exceed HIPAA's baseline — specifically restricting redisclosure of mental health information. ClickMasters designs behavioral health AI with IL MHDDCA protection layers.

blocks.heading: Illinois Hospital Licensing Act
paragraphs: Clinical AI tools used in licensed Illinois hospitals must align with IDPH hospital licensing requirements — ClickMasters incorporates IDPH licensing context for clinical applications.

blocks.heading: Cook County Medicaid (CountyCare)
paragraphs: CCH's CountyCare managed care plan serves one of the US's largest county Medicaid populations — AI for CCH must align with Illinois HFS (Healthcare and Family Services) Medicaid program requirements.
